[P2] Reconcile canonical numeric displays with exact expectations

For a service result of `1e4096`, `_display_json()` produces the string `"1e4096"` because the integer exceeds its 4096-digit display limit. A declared numeric expectation of `10**4096` has the same fingerprint, but this string-versus-number comparison rejects it, incorrectly failing a matching result. After verifying the fingerprint, compare against the expectation's corresponding display projection while preserving the distinction from an actual JSON string. Add regression coverage for this boundary.
